subject: Area map surface: the unfogged right-hand strip

build.area: Manaan - West Central (module m26, texture lbl_mapm26ab)

runtime.method: x64dbg, software breakpoint at VA 0x006944A8, live process
runtime.note: The rect is read from [ebx+0x04..0x10]. ebx is the icon container, the object whose size is written by the immediate at VA 0x00695082. It is the MARKER OVERLAY, not the map canvas.

live_constants_read_from_patched_exe.method: struct.unpack_from on the installed swkotor.exe, gold v19 at 3440x1440

captures.name: fog-test-1720.png
captures.divisor_source: float in allocated page, live memory patch

derived.strip_width_rule: strip = canvas_width - overlay_width = 1720 - 1478 = 242. Measured 242 in all four captures, independent of the grid divisor.
derived.grid_extent_rule: The grid is clipped to the overlay width regardless of the divisor. Measured 1483/1475/1475/1478 against overlay 1478.
derived.canvas_placement_rule: canvas_left = LBL_Map.left + (screenWidth - centringX) / 2. Exact at centringX=3440 (delta 0 px); +5 px at centringX=2750, which is one grid-line width.
derived.clip_requirement: For LBL_Map to clip the canvas at the overlay, canvas_left must equal LBL_Map.left, which requires centringX == screenWidth.

atlas.method: pykotor read of swpc_tex_gui.erf, and of the installed HD override
atlas.conclusion: The atlas carries real picture past column 440 in BOTH vanilla and the HD pack. The strip is not caused by the HD map textures.

disproved.claim: The 1720 private-float build (v19b) never took effect.
disproved.disproof: map-fog-v19b.png measures a pitch of exactly 86.0 = 1720/20. It took effect; it simply did not move the strip.

disproved.claim: The strip is caused by the HD map textures.
disproved.disproof: The vanilla 512x256 atlas has the same content past column 440 (mean 33.6 vs 33.9).

disproved.claim: The grid divisor controls where the grid ends.
disproved.disproof: Divisors 1478 and 1720 both produce a grid clipped at ~1478 and a strip of exactly 242 px.

frame_art.method: tools/measure_map_screen.py reports off-pitch bright runs as grid.rejected_runs. Runs present in both captures with the canvas in different places are fixed art; runs that move with the canvas are drawn with it.
frame_art.conclusion: 2580-2613 is present in both, unmoved, while the canvas moved 340 px: fixed frame art, interior right edge about 2580. Frame interior is therefore about 860..2580 = 1720 px = screenWidth // 2, which is exactly KMRP's canvas width. Option A (a 2365-wide map) would overflow it.
frame_art.caveat: Measured at 3440x1440 only. Whether frameInterior == screenWidth // 2 holds at other resolutions is UNTESTED.

recommended_fix.name: Option D
recommended_fix.rule: canvas = (screenWidth // 2) * 512/440; overlay = canvas * 440/512 = screenWidth // 2; canvasHeight = overlayHeight = screenHeight // 2
recommended_fix.effect: Visible map content grows from 1478 to 1720 px (+16.4%) and fills the frame; the strip is cropped by LBL_Map exactly as vanilla crops its 72 columns.
